review_candidates.title: People Change Consultant
review_candidates.description: Role Description The People Change Consultant plays a key role in supporting organizations through business transformation, workforce change, and evolving ways of working. This role focuses on the people side of change, helping ensure that organizational initiatives are effectively communicated, understood, adopted, and sustained. You will work closely with business leaders, stakeholders, project teams, and employees to assess the impact of change and develop practical strategies that support successful implementation. The role involves understanding organizational culture, employee needs, stakeholder expectations, and business priorities to create change approaches that are clear, structured, and people-focused. Key responsibilities include supporting change management strategies, conducting stakeholder and impact assessments, developing communication and engagement plans, and identifying potential barriers to successful adoption. You will help translate complex business changes into clear messages and actionable plans that enable employees and stakeholders to understand what is changing, why it matters, and how it may affect their work. The People Change Consultant will contribute to employee engagement initiatives and support activities designed to strengthen organizational readiness. You may facilitate workshops, stakeholder discussions, feedback sessions, and other engagement activities to encourage collaboration and participation throughout the change process. You will partner with cross-functional teams to align people-related activities with wider business objectives. This includes supporting leadership teams with change communication, identifying areas where additional support may be required, and helping develop practical solutions to improve employee adoption and transition. The role also involves monitoring the progress and effectiveness of change initiatives. You will gather feedback, review engagement and adoption outcomes, identify emerging challenges, and recommend adjustments where necessary. A strong ability to analyze information and understand different perspectives will be important when supporting complex organizational environments. You will contribute to the development of change frameworks, tools, templates, and best practices that can support consistent and effective change delivery. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail. Success in this position requires excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving abilities. You should be comfortable working with diverse stakeholders and navigating changing priorities while maintaining a professional, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Psychology, Management, or a related field. Strong understanding of organizational change, people transformation, employee engagement, and business transformation principles. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities. Ability to understand different organizational perspectives and work collaboratively with teams across multiple functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify challenges and recommend practical solutions. Ability to conduct stakeholder assessments and evaluate the potential people impact of organizational initiatives. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities and priorities effectively. Confidence in facilitating discussions, workshops, meetings, and engagement activities. Ability to develop clear communication materials, presentations, and change-related documentation. Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader business objectives. Comfortable working in dynamic environments where priorities and requirements may evolve. Ability to handle sensitive workplace matters professionally and maintain appropriate confidentiality. A collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams. Familiarity with change management methodologies, organizational development practices, or people transformation frameworks is an advantage. Professional certifications related to change management, organizational development, project management, or human resources are considered beneficial. Strong proficiency in common business and collaboration tools used for presentations, communication, documentation, and project coordination. A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-focused approach with the ability to support positive outcomes during periods of organizational change.

review_candidates.title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering
review_candidates.description: Level : Leadership The Role The Head of Forward Deployed Engineering owns the bridge between the company customers, delivery, Product, and Platform Engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for scaling how the company designs, deploys, and operates agentic systems with customers. You will build the FDE organization, establish delivery and architectural standards, develop implementation partners, and ensure lessons from customer deployments continuously improve the company platform. You will also play a senior role in strategic customer engagements, from discovery and solution architecture through production rollout, expansion, and handover. The objective is not to build a large bespoke services organization. It is to create a scalable delivery model where customer needs are increasingly solved through reusable patterns, platform capabilities, and a strong ecosystem of FDEs and implementation partners. Mission ● Build and lead company's Forward Deployed Engineering function. ● Establish a repeatable approach for designing, deploying, evaluating, and operating enterprise agentic systems. ● Create a reinforcing loop: deploy with customers → learn what repeats → improve the platform → enable FDEs and partners → deploy faster and more reliably. Responsibilities Lead Forward Deployed Engineering ● Hire, onboard, mentor, and manage a high-performing FDE team. ● Build playbooks, onboarding processes, reference architectures, review mechanisms, and escalation paths. ● Establish standards for technical quality, customer ownership, documentation, observability, evaluation, and production readiness. ● Remain technically hands-on and step into complex or strategic deployments when needed. Own Solution and Architecture Standards ● Define standards for agentic workflows across orchestration, context, memory, retrieval, tool use, human review, guardrails, observability, and evaluation. ● Maintain a clear separation between the system brain — reasoning, policies, planning, context, and evaluation — and the hands — APIs, tools, connectors, and deterministic actions. ● Establish architecture reviews and deployment-readiness processes. ● Raise the production bar through robust tracing, testing, failure handling, security controls, and outcome-based evaluation. ● Ensure teams prefer company's platform capabilities and reusable patterns over bespoke implementations. Connect the Field to Product and Platform ● Create a tight operating rhythm between FDE, Product, and Platform Engineering. ● Identify recurring customer needs, architectural gaps, and implementation friction. ● Translate field learnings into reusable primitives, templates, tooling, product requirements, and platform capabilities. ● Determine what should remain customer-specific, what belongs in reusable implementation logic, and what should become part of company's platform. Scale Delivery Through Partners ● Build the operating model for external implementation partners. ● Define technical standards, delivery frameworks, enablement, certification expectations, and quality controls. ● Review partner implementations and hold partners accountable for customer outcomes, technical quality, timelines, and maintainability. ● Help partners move from bespoke delivery toward standardized company's architectures and platform capabilities. Lead Strategic Customer Deployments ● Act as a senior technical counterpart in strategic customer engagements. ● Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear agent architectures, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes. ● Guide teams through difficult technical decisions, enterprise integrations, production constraints, and stakeholder trade-offs. ● Design deployments to expand across new agents, workflows, and business units over time. Core Requirements ● Strong software engineering foundation with experience building and operating production systems. ● Hands-on depth in LLM applications and agentic systems, including orchestration, tool calling, context management, retrieval, evaluation, and debugging. ● Strong backend, API, integration, and data-flow design skills. ● Experience leading customer-facing technical delivery, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or an equivalent function. ● Experience managing and developing engineers while remaining technically credible. ● Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into clear architectures, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes. ● Strong product and technical judgment, particularly around distinguishing customer-specific requirements from reusable platform capabilities. ● Strong communication across customers, engineers, Product, Platform, partners, and company leadership. ● Ability to balance urgent customer needs with long-term platform quality and scalability. Strong Signals ● You have shipped production agentic systems and can discuss real reliability failures, evaluation strategies, architectural trade-offs, and lessons learned. ● You have built reusable SDKs, frameworks, connectors, templates, or internal platforms based on patterns discovered across multiple deployments. ● You have operated in early-stage B2B AI or enterprise software where product and customer delivery evolve together. ● You have built or scaled a customer-facing engineering organization. ● You have successfully developed engineers and managed external engineering or implementation partners. ● You naturally think in systems, reusable patterns, and operating models rather than solving every customer problem independently. ● You are comfortable challenging customers and internal teams when proposed solutions introduce unnecessary complexity or undermine platform scalability. Preferred Experience Experience with modern agent frameworks and model tooling such as LangGraph, OpenAI agent tooling, or equivalent systems is valuable, as is experience with enterprise security, identity, data governance, networking, regulated environments, partner-led delivery models, and scaling enterprise AI deployments across multiple customers and geographies. Competitive Salary Other Benefits: ESOP

review_candidates.title: Flight Operations Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Our client is a growing private aviation company committed to delivering safe, efficient, and exceptional flight operations. As the company continues expanding its operations, they are seeking a Flight Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day execution of private aircraft operations by coordinating logistics, communicating with key stakeholders, and ensuring every flight operates smoothly within a fast-paced Part 135 environment. Role Overview The Flight Operations Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating daily flight logistics between pilots, passengers, Fixed Base Operators (FBOs), maintenance providers, brokers, hotels, ground transportation vendors, and internal teams. The Flight Operations Coordinator will support operational planning, vendor management, customer communication, documentation, and flight coordination while ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient execution of every flight. This role is ideal for someone with private aviation experience who thrives in fast-paced operational environments and enjoys solving logistical challenges while delivering exceptional customer service. Location Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Key Responsibilities Flight Coordination & Operational Support Coordinate daily flight logistics with pilots, passengers, brokers, FBOs, ground transportation providers, hotels, and maintenance vendors. Communicate flight schedules, operational updates, and itinerary changes to all stakeholders. Support the Operations team in managing day-of-flight logistics. Monitor operational timelines and proactively identify scheduling conflicts or disruptions. Vendor Management Coordinate hotels, rental vehicles, fuel providers, catering, and other operational vendors. Assist with maintaining preferred vendor relationships and pricing. Verify pilot expense reports and supporting documentation for accuracy and compliance. Monitor vendor performance and escalate service issues when necessary. Customer & Broker Communication Serve as the primary point of contact for brokers, passengers, pilots, and vendors throughout the flight coordination process. Provide timely updates regarding delays, itinerary changes, and operational adjustments. Deliver exceptional customer service in time-sensitive situations. Documentation & Operational Compliance Maintain accurate flight records and operational documentation. Ensure operational information is properly recorded within internal systems. Support administrative tasks that contribute to efficient daily flight operations. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, Dispatch, and Executive Leadership. Support process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. Contribute to a collaborative and solutions-oriented team environment. Qualifications Experience 2–5 years of experience coordinating private aviation or Part 135 flight operations. Prior experience supporting business aviation flight departments is required. Experience coordinating with pilots, FBOs, maintenance providers, brokers, and third-party vendors. Familiarity with FAA regulations and private aviation operational procedures is highly preferred. Experience managing multiple flight operations simultaneously. Skills Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to prioritize multiple flights and competing operational demands. Experience using flight operations or scheduling software. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. Strong operational documentation and recordkeeping skills. Excellent customer service and relationship management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. Ability to remain calm under pressure in time-sensitive environments. Professional, proactive, and highly accountable. What Success Looks Like Flight operations are coordinated accurately, efficiently, and with minimal disruption. Pilots, passengers, brokers, and vendors consistently receive timely and professional communication. Vendor relationships are effectively managed, resulting in reliable operational support. Flight documentation, expense reporting, and operational records remain accurate and organized. Internal teams rely on the Flight Operations Coordinator as a dependable operational partner. Operational processes continue to improve through proactive communication and collaboration. Opportunity This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing private aviation company where operational excellence is essential to every flight. As the Flight Operations Coordinator , you'll play a critical role in coordinating aircraft operations, supporting internal teams, and delivering an exceptional experience for passengers, pilots, and business partners while building a long-term career within the aviation industry.
